notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Town Builders,[/p][p]Over the past two weeks, besides routine bug fixes, we've focused mainly on:[/p][list][*][p]Reworking the furniture categories: now you can browse by space or function, with brand-new secondary filters, favorites, and improved icons for recoloring and four-way rotation, plus more filtering options.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/c8cc70e3dc3537b8ab341635caa8ce4e4d734e84.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Adding three new houses (small, medium, large) that can be discovered in town – all of them support floorplan changes.
[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing 100+ new pieces of furniture, with more complete sets available.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/41b1b3844cad41815fec7e51df795930117c9c58.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Creating an independent Building Materials category, including new windows, partitions, and railings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/d6d71ba06460af58a5159a2b98963757de83c60d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Adding RGB color customization for more freedom, and allowing wall/floor editing in the starter home's kitchen and bathroom.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/4d6396b9b0a6414b8012e7e13be67acd00438a51.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Updating our trailer, now featuring community-selected decoration highlights – thank you for sharing your creations![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]v1.0.1.0 Patch Notes[/h3][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some rotated objects in the Graveyard prevented quest completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock during bartending.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal duplicate occurrences.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI and icon display errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed furniture disappearing or being unplaceable in the Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Storage refresh not updating after recycling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ideal Home Showroom items incorrectly allowed in the Storage .[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed color customization errors on certain furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed outlines showing when hovering during photo mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual errors (layers, volumes, exposure).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animation issues with the Science Gift Box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mattress errors after room switching.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hospital drawer blocked by incorrect collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input being disabled after accidentally triggering a text field.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed leftover occlusion after rotating containers (tables, etc.) around other items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ovens locking incorrectly after cooling when switching rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam Deck videos not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed counter errors when recycling dishes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bathtub interaction errors after cloud save conflicts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ideal Home Showroom/presets not storing feature data.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ideal Home Showroom/presets not saving animation states.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed extra counting of objects in Company test quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing localization in some places.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted art for several objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain UI displays.[/p][/*][*][p]Made Subspace objects non-removable.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some junk pile locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted outer outline flicker effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New & Improved Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added bus stop names to the Town.[/p][/*][*][p]Added recolor and four-way rotation icons for Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added automatic quest tracking trigger when the robot disappears in the instrument shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added quest tracking tips showing both source object and placement target.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sticker transparency settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added one-click option in the Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiple objects supporting four-way rotation and more states.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more achievement completion methods.[/p][/*][*][p]Added automatic virtual keyboard on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Added keybinding reset function.[/p][/*][*][p]All player homes and random Ideal Home Showroom:[/p][list][*][p]Windows updated visually.[/p][/*][*][p]Windows are now movable, purchasable, sellable, and storable in Storage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated recolor panel: new [b]Advanced Mode – Free Color[/b] plus improved dual-color visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Starter home kitchen and bathroom: added new recolor skins (two variants).[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new houses and quests, plus house-purchasing feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated warehouse categories: new [b]space-based[/b] and [b]function-based[/b] filters, with secondary filter support.[/p][/*][*][p]Added purchasable clothes racks at the clothing store.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized preset cover image display.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]✨ Thank you again for all your feedback and for sharing your wonderful creations – your support keeps making the town more lively and cozy!

—GD Studio[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.7
notes.notes: [p][b]v1.0.0.7 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed collision in 54*36 Ideal Home Showroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing interaction hint for the Fishie's lamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed material update error for snow in the main scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect fire hydrant interaction effect in the main scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Presets now store recolor states.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted size of Orange Blossom Perfume.[/p][/*][*][p]Added four-way rotation for the Mini Fan.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issue when the cabinet door in Hospital Room 205 was open and the player switched rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Timeline display is now enabled by default.[/p][/*][*][p]After controlling the weather, daily weather refresh will no longer occur.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.6
notes.notes:
[p][b]v1.0.0.6 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Replaced problematic and questionable assets[/p][/*][*][p]Added fine-tuning sensitivity option; holding LT on controller switches sensitivity.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where custom interaction keys were not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Added keyboard controls for camera zoom in/out.[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom key bindings: Zoom In, Zoom Out.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed time display from the weather UI; weather panel now auto-hides.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Ideal Home where saves loaded too late, causing features to miss loading (stacking left only one book).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed right joystick scrolling in the storage being too slow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization error when putting potted plants into the storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors when placing containers in Subspace or Luna’s secret room.[/p][/*][*][p]Added long-press hint for the bakery mirror.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed priority logic error in the upper-left display of sand piles.[/p][/*][*][p]Added setting to display timeline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an extra record appearing in the collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed preset blank slot count increasing too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some localization issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect inventory deduction when loading presets requiring combined items (e.g., mattress composition reading error).[/p][/*][*][p]Presets will no longer clear items when there are insufficient items in the warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after cleaning garbage, running it off screen before the UI animation finished would cause it to remain uncleared.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed preset images displaying incorrectly; local images now delete properly when presets are removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted volume (size) of the kitchen knife.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed issue where Jane’s deletion timing was not correct, causing two Janes to appear.[/p][/*][/list][p]
We sincerely apologize to the Moonfrost team, their artists, and those who have been following Whisper of the House for the misused assets. We will continue to conduct a thorough review of all our assets to ensure that no questionable materials remain.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.5
notes.notes:
[p][b]v1.0.0.5 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rotation errors on the [b]Mountain-Shaped Brush Holder[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed volume issue of the [b]Vibrant Orange Sink Cabinet[/b].
[i](Players should move any items placed on top of the sink before updating, otherwise those items may be lost.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed volume issue of the [b]Gold Vintage Shower Head[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]White Rose[/b] is no longer obtainable by the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed light offset of the [b]Star Desk Lamp[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Baked Croissant[/b] and [b]Burnt Croissant[/b] can now be unlocked automatically (no rotation required).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]IV Stand[/b] to be movable, and made the backs of chairs and sofas pickable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal behavior of the [b]Chocolate Metal Bed Frame[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal trigger behavior of [b]Firework[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated image of the [b]Vibrant Orange Induction Stove Cabinet[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added confirmation prompts when saving or applying presets.[/p][/*][*][p]Limited hospital task tracking to Room 205 and the restroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where random placements were not counted in quest progress when saving on game exit, which could cause the Alchemist quest to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where exiting and re-entering allowed the music store to complete automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tutorial quest tracking to follow incorrect item placements instead of ghost targets.[/p][/*][*][p]ESC undo action now correctly updates quest progress when items return to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect streetlight positions on the world map.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated warehouse item icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some newspapers could not be reopened in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the name of [b]Cute Scale[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tips for recycle mode in both Ideal Home and Player’s Home warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shelf UI display issues in inventory categories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed truncated item names under different resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Red Heart Pattern Coat Rack[/b] could not hold clothes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing thumbnail for [b]Scientist Design Draft 2[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted price of the [b]Cake Menu Board[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music playback interface blocking other UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted colliders for [b]Red Leaf Plant[/b], [b]Green-Purple Plant[/b], [b]Leafy Vegetable Plant[/b], and [b]Red Mushroom Plant[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new “50x Draw” features for the Furniture Store, Appliance Store, Newsstand, and General Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing decoration category tags for records [b]Time Capsule[/b] and [b]Novice Housekeeper[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.4
notes.notes: [p][b]v1.0.0.4 Patch Notes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a patch for players who did not receive the Alchemy Workshop quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock issue when placing items in Grandpa’s room.[/p][/*][*][p]Allowed hospital sofas, tables, and chairs to be picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect properties of certain items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing items in drawers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the key remapping page did not display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display errors at 21:9 resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Storage search is now case-insensitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Added item categories and filters to the Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved flowerpots from the Decoration category to the Plant category.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing icons for certain items in Storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a filter in the Collection to show whether items are unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a guide for quest tracking.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the long-press button prompt icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added preset functions for player owned homes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with obtaining and using the bus card.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the “Fairytale Fantasy” achievement: now unlocks upon entering the fantasy world.[/p][/*][*][p]The game time is now paused when the Setting panel is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where plants in the flower shop could not grow.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
[p][b]v1.0.0.3 Patch Notes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Experience Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Naming page now defaults to selecting the input box.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a close button for Tarot cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted cutscene colors (reduced contrast).[/p][/*][*][p]Ideal Home Showroom windows are now movable, but cannot be stored in the storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added validation in the Ideal Home Showroom to check whether items can be placed into storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings → Gameplay: Added “Lost Items Rest” button
(When encountering rooms with errors such as the hospital towel bug, this feature can randomly restore misplaced objects.)[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemist: added two new task trackers.[/p][/*][*][p]Luna’s: added task tracker for footprints.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some colliders.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where objects could be taken out of theIdeal Home Showroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items could be lost if auto-save triggered while holding them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added height restriction for placing items on the display shelf.[/p][/*][*][p]Music store carpet can now be rotated and still be recognized as correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Light bulb in the basement now displays when placed on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the display effect of the close button on Melody’s letter.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the default orientation of some items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues where items could be carried through doors unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some oversized texture issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated icons of Preset.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted fix for lost items during crafting with multiple recipes (items will now attempt to restore).[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed some items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain Ideal Home Showroom layouts not loading correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where walls in Ideal Home Showroom layouts had no space to place large objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Mark could be carried into the hospital restroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock in the Lady Bai’s mansion living room; removed side panel and faucet from the chef’s counter.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The DEMO version has been updated!
notes.notes: [p]【DEMO 0.8.2.1 Patch Note】[/p][p]Dear players, We’re excited to announce a new update for the Whisper of the House demo! [/p][p]Please note the following important information: [/p][p]This update may cause errors when loading old save files. [/p][p]If you’d like to continue using your previous saves, you can go back to the previous versions【legacy-Old stable version】from the Betas section in the Whisper of the House Demo properties on Steam:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/ca605c8d41dbf8f2c695a2ca219beae74a3583ef.png"][/img][/p][p]Since this demo is a brand-new version, previous save files can’t be carried over.[/p][p]As a special thank-you, we’ve given out 2,000 coupons to players who tried the previous version—feel free to check it out in-game![/p][p][/p][p]Update Notes: [/p][olist][*][p]Added Mac version [/p][/*][*][p]Added photo filters, stickers, frames, and more [/p][/*][*][p]Added key binding options[/p][/*][*][p]Added new interactive elements to certain maps[/p][/*][*][p]Added floor plan view [/p][/*][*][p]Added search function in the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Improved quest guidance [/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall performance [/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller support [/p][/*][*][p]Improved mouse controls and tooltips [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted save system logic [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted initial furniture layout in some levels [/p][/*][*][p]Updated Luna’s Escape Room story and flow [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted shop and NPC placements [/p][/*][*][p]Updated item descriptions [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug preventing sleep after rotating beds [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various known softlock issues (e.g., unable to enter Grandpa’s house, take quests, etc.) [/p][/*][*][p]Other bug fixes and improvements[/p][/*][/olist]
